layers.TASKBOOK: task-specific problem contract; authoritative for requested scope
layers.COMMON_SURFACE: accepted reusable knowledge router; not copied wholesale into packs
layers.REASONING_REGISTRY: typed reusable reasoning operators with trust/evidence boundaries
layers.CONTEXT_PACK: derived task-relative working context; never hand-maintained as a second taskbook

selection_channels.EXACT_REQUIRED: selected only from structured signature/declarations/dependencies/accepted negative boundaries/evidence obligations
selection_channels.DIAGNOSTIC_SUGGESTED: selected from auxiliary textual signals or unresolved risk; never injects a conclusion as fact

freshness.rule: irrelevant repository movement does not invalidate a pack; any relevant dependency change does

optional_feedback_fields.meta_tool_delta: compiler-observed unknowns, uncovered capabilities, and omitted candidates for registry feedback; never auto-promotes tools
